description: Delete an access policy by UUID, removing its allow or deny rule and changing access permissions. This cannot be undone by this tool. Inspect get_access_policy first; returns Portkey's acknowledgement, or HTTP 404 when the policy is missing.

id.description: Access policy UUID from list_access_policies or create_access_policy

name: delete_access_policy

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
